notes: GTK exploratory and profile runs overlapped a four-worker Emacs build. Baseline, clipping, native-surface, native-verified and Canvas measurements ran without that build.
The native drawing uses an approximate Pango bounce gradient, with hardcoded light-theme font/colors. It is not the product renderer.
Native modes run on a 33 ms GTK timeout (about 30 Hz); snapshots show submitted/released buffer totals including one second of settling.
Screenshots were captured after the measurement interval. Surface position was subsequently corrected using window-inside-pixel-edges.

Final native60 results use the final recorded probe sources, monotonic phase, posn-derived positioning, and explicit submitted/released frame-rate assertions. Earlier exploratory files predate these refinements.
